<!-- pr-reviewer: 6ca2be070c0bea638b74c0348efccdfa37df4f92 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (stacked on #967/#965; reviewed as `git diff pull/967/head...pull/972/head`).

**What looks good**
- Pure `git mv` plus import/path edits: 12 files, no Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock change, so no new dependency, no dev-dependency cycle, layering unchanged (post/sim/motion/cl tests use only their own crate; cl owns origin_approach and reads `../motion/src` as a file path only).
- Coverage did not ride away: `#[test]` count per file identical before/after (2/5/11/2/2/3/6/7/2/7/3/5 = 55) and `#[ignore]` count is 0 before and after for every file.
- Gate-map headers now name real owner modules; new xtask pin `moved_suites_live_in_their_owner_crate_and_not_in_app` also asserts no `camcraft_app` import in the moved files.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is 19 (#967 = 18), correct for the xtask change. No snapshot PNGs, no CHANGELOG edits; body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #921`.

**Local results** (PR head; no `build.rs`/`.github`/scripts touched)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| post: heidenhain_arc_centre / block_form / cycles, probe_spindle, probe_spindle_stop, comment_escape, lathe_post_refusals, doosan_dnm_post | 2 / 5 / 11 / 2 / 2 / 3 / 6 / 7 passed |
| sim: boundary_walls, real_tip | 2, 3 passed |
| motion: arcs | 7 passed |
| cl: origin_approach | 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 43 passed |
| clippy -D warnings, post/sim/motion/cl/xtask all-targets | clean |
Not run here: app suites / app clippy (the diff only removes files from app tests), ui, full batch. I did not trial-merge main: the PR is stacked, its base moves with #967.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `origin_approach` trade-off, judged: not a regression. I touched `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` and ran `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` on both #967's tree and this head: `origin_approach` is selected in neither (before, its header said "cl::path ... and every motion generator", which names no motion module, so quick never matched it from a motion change either). Batch/release run it in both. A cheap improvement for a follow-up: list the generator modules in its Gate map (e.g. `motion::machining2d, motion::machining3d, ...`), which quick's other-crate matching (`motion::<mod>`) would then pick up.
2. Gate map nits: `origin_approach` says `cl::cl` (the module is `cl::cl` in the crate, fine, but reads oddly); `heidenhain_cycles` ends `post::machine, (post::machine)` - the duplicate can go.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2f29aad0281de190cbe5462d84e5426427869d25 -->
Independent review. Trial-merged with origin/main (a6bd69d8): clean, no conflicts. Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- All 12 moved files compile in their owner crate with no `camcraft_app` import. No `Cargo.toml` is in the diff, so no new crate dependency or dev-dependency.
- `#[test]` count, grep on main vs the PR (and merge-base): heidenhain_arc_centre 2/2, heidenhain_block_form 5/5, heidenhain_cycles 11/11, probe_spindle 2/2, probe_spindle_stop 2/2, comment_escape 3/3, lathe_post_refusals 6/6, doosan_dnm_post 7/7, boundary_walls 2/2, arcs 7/7, real_tip 3/3, origin_approach 5/5 = 55/55.
- Diffing each moved file against main's version (CR ignored): only `use` lines, crate paths and Gate-map comment lines differ. No assertion changed. Main has not touched these files since the merge base, so nothing from main is dropped (other main-side additions, e.g. `adaptive_orbit_seam`, `pocket3d_hsm`, merged in untouched).
- Gate maps now name the real crate (`post::post`, `sim::verify`, `motion::machining2d`).
- The batch dry-run lists the moved suites in their new crates: post (8), sim (`boundary_walls`, `real_tip`), motion (`arcs`), cl (`origin_approach`); none remain in the app list.

**Local results (merged with main)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: all pass (moved: 3, 7, 2, 5, 11, 6, 2, 2).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl`: pass, `origin_approach` 5.
- sim `boundary_walls` 2, `real_tip` 3; motion `arcs` 7: pass.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 44 passed.
- clippy `--all-targets -D warnings` on post, cl, sim, motion: clean.
- Not built: app and ui suites (as asked).

**Required step (not a blocker):** the branch includes the #965/#967 commits (stack); PROCESS_VERSION is 19 here. Merge main and take the next free number when it lands.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- The moved post tests still read goldens from `crates/app/tests/golden` by a `../app/...` style path; that works but is a cross-crate file path. Fine as the PR says (nothing copied).
- `origin_approach` now lives in cl but scans `../motion/src`; a change only under `crates/motion/src` no longer selects it in quick (the PR notes this; batch still runs it).
- Gate map for `origin_approach` reads "covers cl::cl", which looks like an over-eager rename.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
